component when decommissioning older systems.

e Data Destruction

This action destroys data from the database in an archiving write session and then in a subsequent delete run. This creates
temporary archive files which the system deletes automatically with the file-related administration data at the end of the
deletion phase. A run is classified as a destruction run in technical terms by the DESTROY parameter. If an archiving object
has not been registered in the Information Retention Manager (IRM), the system ignores the DESTROY parameter and

executes a standard archiving session.
3. Deletion of TOU Exceptions from the Database (Report REAARCH_DEL_EXRESP)
Process Flow

The deletion report reads TOU exceptions that were previously archived in an archiving run from the archive and deletes the
corresponding entries in the database tables.

If you start the report in the test mode, the system determines the number of data records to be deleted for TOU exceptions that
were read from the archive.

4. Optional Reloading of Archived and Deleted Data (Report REAARCH_REL_EXCEPT)

Process Flow

The REAARCH_REL_EXCEPT report reloads TOU exceptions that have been archived and already deleted, and reverses all
changes made to the database by the deletion program.

i Note

You can only use the reload program to reload complete archiving runs. It is not possible to reload individual TOU exceptions.
This procedure should not normally be used and should be limited to extreme problem cases (for example, incorrect retention
period in Customizing).

When you start the report, you can make various settings on the initial screen:

e Log Type: General statistical data or detail log with detailed data for each analyzed data record (note that making this
setting can become confusing if large amounts of data are involved).

e Test Run: If you start the report as a test run, no changes are made to the database.
5. Optional Reading of TOU Exceptions from the Archive and Output in a List (Report REAARCH_READ_ARCHIVE_EXCEPT)

Process Flow

You use report REAARCH_ READ ARCHIVE EXCEPT after running the archiving report REAARCH_ARCH_EXCEPT to gain read-
only access to an archive and to display data for TOU exceptions in a list.

You do not have run the deletion program first.
